DHE-15/129/2026-EDU GENERAL-Directorate of Higher Education                                                        I/1774172/2026




                                          GOVERNMENT OF ASSAM
                           OFFICE OF THE DIRECTOR OF HIGHER EDUCATION, ASSAM
                                        KAHILIPARA, GUWAHATI -19
                No.E.842761/2026/30

                From:                 Sri Titu Gogoi, AES
                                      Dy. Director of Higher Education, Assam,
                                      Kahilipara, Guwahati-19.

                To:                The Principal,
                All Govt./Provincialised/Govt. Model Colleges & PDUAMs.

                Sub:             Continuation of existing provisions and guidelines under the Fee Waiver
                Scheme for the Academic Session 2026-27.

                Ref:                  Govt. letter No.E-780492/2026/9 dated 29.08.2026.

                Sir/Madam,

                                     With reference to the subject cited above, I am directed to inform you that
                memorandum have been received from various College Students' Unions raising objections to
                the revised provision requiring students having backlog/arrears to pay 50% of the prescribed
                admission fee, and requesting restoration of 100% fee waiver along with refund of the amount
                already paid by the concerned students.

                                            The matter was accordingly forwarded to the Govt. for necessary
                consideration and instructions.

                                      In this regard, the Govt. has informed that the matter has been carefully
                examined by the Department and, after due consideration of all relevant aspects, the competent
                authority has decided to maintain and continue the existing provisions and guidelines as laid
                down in the prevailing Oﬀice Memorandum governing the Fee Waiver Scheme for the Academic
                Session 2026-27.

                                  You are, therefore, requested to circulate the aforesaid decision of the Govt.
                 among all concerned students of the institution for information and necessary compliance.

                (Enclo: Copy under Ref.)

                                                                        Yours faithfully,




                                                               Dy. Director of Higher Education, Assam
                                                                      Kahilipara, Guwahati- 19.

                Memo. No.E.842761/2026/30 -A
                Copy to:-

                    1. P.S. to the Commissioner & Secretary to the Govt. of Assam, Higher Education
                        Department, Dispur, Ghy-06 for kind appraisal of C&S.
                    2. P.A. to the Director of Higher Education, Assam, Kahilipara, Ghy-19 for kind appraisal of
                        DHE

                                                                        (e-Signed)

                                                               Dy. Director of Higher Education, Assam
                                                                    Kahilipara, Guwahati-19
